🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION, not a broad risk-off signal. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, a Sector Strength reading; Technology was negative while Healthcare and Consumer sectors led. Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5; neither narrow nor broad). Major divergence across large stocks argues for restraint and confirmation.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: UNH (1W: +10.99% | 1M: +11.04%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples: MNST (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +6.91%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Discretionary: SBUX (1W: +8.01% | 1M: +4.71%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is weakest by sector return: AMD (1W: -11.69% | 1M: -13.12%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -8.42% | 1M: -11.40%) BELOW TREND. Utilities and Industrials also lagged: CEG (1W: -12.49% | 1M: -1.25%) BELOW TREND and ETN (1W: -10.82% | 1M: -12.28%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: ACN (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +29.51%) ABOVE TREND; INTU (1W: +11.23% | 1M: +10.76%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +10.99% | 1M: +11.04%) ABOVE TREND; LLY (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND; LMT (1W: +8.87% | 1M: +2.49%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5; neither narrow nor broad).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PANW (1W: -14.29% | 1M: -8.47%) BELOW TREND; AMAT (1W: -12.76% | 1M: -12.76%) BELOW TREND; LRCX (1W: -12.51% | 1M: -12.75%) BELOW TREND; AMD (1W: -11.69% | 1M: -13.12%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -10.82% | 1M: -24.71%) BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Technology.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W momentum among the reported leaders: ACN (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +29.51%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +11.23% | 1M: +10.76%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +10.99% | 1M: +11.04%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence is evident: AAPL (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +0.15%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -2.13% | 1M: +6.03%) CORRECTION and JPM (1W: +1.16% | 1M: -4.29%) RECOVERY; watch for a trend break.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak at the sector level, down 3.21% for the week, but internally mixed: ACN (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +29.51%) ABOVE TREND and INTU (1W: +11.23% | 1M: +10.76%) ABOVE TREND contrast with NVDA (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -4.80%) BELOW TREND and META (1W: -8.95% | 1M: -6.34%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: negative on a 1W sector-return basis; stock-level positive counts were not provided.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials gained 1.19% this week but remain down 1.11% over the month, consistent with rotation rather than clear leadership. V (1W: +2.65% | 1M: +9.90%) ABOVE TREND and MA (1W: +2.58% | 1M: +9.46%) ABOVE TREND show strength, while JPM (1W: +1.16% | 1M: -4.29%) RECOVERY is a short-term bounce; stock-level breadth was not provided.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Strong, with the sector up 5.71% for the week and 5.90% for the month. UNH (1W: +10.99% | 1M: +11.04%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND confirm leadership; stock-level breadth was not provided.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor demonstrated strength in Healthcare and selected Consumer names, while reducing exposure to weak Technology momentum selectively; ACN (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +29.51%) ABOVE TREND contrasts with AMD (1W: -11.69% | 1M: -13.12%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; major cross-timeframe divergences make this a tactical opportunity, not a core-position signal.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: UNH (1W: +10.99% | 1M: +11.04%) ABOVE TREND and ACN (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +29.51%) ABOVE TREND, if gains persist. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -10.82% | 1M: -24.71%) BELOW TREND and LRCX (1W: -12.51% | 1M: -12.75%) BELOW TREND, unless selling pressure eases.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare, up 5.71% for the week and 5.90% for the month, with 9/11 sectors positive overall. BEARISH: Technology, down 3.21% for the week and 1.09% for the month; Utilities also slipped 0.65% this week.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Spot-price levels were not supplied, so specific price support and resistance cannot be verified. Monitor whether NVDA (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -4.80%) BELOW TREND stabilizes, whether AAPL (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +0.15%) CORRECTION resumes its monthly advance, and whether JPM (1W: +1.16% | 1M: -4.29%) RECOVERY extends.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (+65): FAA approval for the 737 Max 10; BA (1W: +2.13% | 1M: -5.31%) RECOVERY shows a short-term bounce, but monthly weakness leaves confirmation incomplete. NVDA (+45): reported SpaceX chip demand; NVDA (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -4.80%) BELOW TREND diverges from the positive headline. INTC (+45): JPMorgan upgrade; INTC (1W: -10.82% | 1M: -24.71%) BELOW TREND also diverges, with price action not confirming the news.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AAPL (-50): analyst caution on the iPhone maker; AAPL (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +0.15%) CORRECTION is consistent with near-term pressure, though monthly performance is marginally positive. LRCX (-45): price-target cut ahead of earnings; LRCX (1W: -12.51% | 1M: -12.75%) BELOW TREND confirms the negative sentiment.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION is the exact regime, with 9/11 sectors positive and style mixed / no clear leadership; Top-5 leadership spans three sectors. Relative strength is concentrated in ACN (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +29.51%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +10.99% | 1M: +11.04%) ABOVE TREND. Monitor major divergence in AAPL (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +0.15%) CORRECTION and MSFT (1W: -2.13% | 1M: +6.03%) CORRECTION, alongside positive news that is not yet confirmed by NVDA (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -4.80%) BELOW TREND.
